'''Internal Security''' was the internal [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security]] and [[Spy/Legends|counterintelligence]] division of the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]]. It was charged with protecting the Intelligence Service, monitoring internal communications, and providing an updated status on the state of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government.
